Some celebrations are made brighter by the little things that shine. ✨

Here’s to a new partnership, and many more moments worth celebrating together. ✨

মৃন্ময়ী থেকে চিন্ময়ী..... চিরন্তনীর যাত্রা। 

It begins with earth.
With hands that know the language of clay, and a quiet prayer whispered into every curve. 
From Kumartuli’s clay to the Ma we wait all year to welcome home. ❤️
Layer by layer, prayer by prayer, she takes shape, carrying our memories, longing and love.

Pujo begins the moment Ma begins to take shape. 🌺✨
And at SEBBA, we bring that emotion home — Pujo with a Heart❤️

#bengalisinbangalore #sebba2026 #southbangalorebengalis #bangaloredurgapuja #pujovibes

For a Bangali, Pujo is never complete without gaan, naach, kobita, natok… without a stage that comes alive with our stories, our talent and our love for culture. ❤️

This Pujo, come home to the warmth of music, dance, laughter, memories and togetherness. 🌺🎶

📅 17–21 October 2026 | 📍 White House, HSR Layout

Here’s our Cultural Programme Schedule.
Come, be a part of the celebration. Come, make memories. ❤️✨

Pujo with a Heart ❤️ — always better together !!

#sebba2026 #bangalorebengaliassociation #bengalisinbangalore #southbangalorebengalis #bangaloredurgapuja

This Durga Puja, let the magic of music take over! ❤️

SEBBA invites you to a soulful musical tribute to the legendary duo — Asha Bhosle & R.D. Burman 🎤🎼

🌸 18th October | Ashtami
🕕 6:00 PM onwards
📍 White Housse, HSR Layout, Bengaluru

Come celebrate Maa Durga with timeless melodies, nostalgia, and an evening filled with music that never goes out of style. ❤️

Bring your family, bring your friends, and come sing along! 🎶✨

Maa Asche! ❤️
See you at SEBBA Durga Puja!

Watching a shapeless mound of earth transform into the Lord of Wisdom is a beautiful reminder of our own journeys. Just as the artisan patiently sculpts every detail, life molds us through experiences, shaping our intellect and spirit.

May Lord Ganesha remove all obstacles from your path and bless you with deep knowledge and clarity.

Happy Ganesh Chaturthi From SEBBA family to you all! 🙏🌸

#GaneshChaturthi #ClayToWisdom #sebba2026
#bengalisinbangalore #ganeshpuja

May Lord Ganesha inspire us to choose wisdom over worry 🧠, courage over obstacles 💪, and compassion over conflict ❤️.

Wishing our community a joyful, harmonious and blessed Ganesh Chaturthi 🪔🌺🐘✨🙏

#sebba2026 #ganeshchaturthi #ganpatibappa #bengalisinbangalore #indianculture❤️

Some memories fade.
Some stay with us....like the sound of dhaak 🥁, the warmth of togetherness ❤️, and the magic of Pujo ✨🌺

2025 gave us memories to cherish.
2026 is ready to give us many more. 🎉💫

More music 🎶 More masti 🥳 More laughter 😄 More celebration 💃🕺
And, as always, a place where everyone feels they belong. 🫶🏡

Because SEBBA is more than a Pujo. It’s “Pujo with a Heart” ❤️ your little home away from home. 🏡✨

Come, celebrate. Come, belong. Let’s make 2026 unforgettable! 🌸🎊✨

From 17th - 21st October....once again at White Housse, HSR Layout.
